mapper.select: SELECT event.* FROM torn_stock_signal_event event WHERE round_time >= #{startTime} AND round_time < #{endTime} AND portfolio_decision = 'REJECTED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_stock_virtual_batch batch WHERE batch.signal_event_id = event.id AND batch.ledger_type = 'REJECTED_OBSERVATION' AND batch.deleted = 0 ) AND resolved_at IS NULL AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY round_time ASC, id ASC
